title: Sparse Matrix
description: Write a Zig program that implements a sparse matrix using coordinate (COO) format.
hints: Coordinate (COO) format stores non-zero entries as (row, col, value) triplets
This is memory-efficient for sparse matrices with few non-zero elements
Structs with named fields can be initialized with `.field = value` syntax
Use a fixed-size array of entries for the sparse representation
